description.html: Small toilets save more space, a modern and compact design. This small toilet is designed for very small spaces, but the compact toilet looks perfect in every modern bathroom. This one-piece skirted toilet not only hides the curved sewage pipe but also enhances the elegant appearance of the toilet; by eliminating the gap between the tank and bowl, it eliminates the hiding places for dirt and debris, making it easy to clean. The seat cover of this dual-flush round one-piece universal height skirt toilet closes quietly without making any noise. The dual-flush toilet flushes a powerful 1.1/1.6 GPF, which is very reliable and also saves water. This version of the toilet comes with a very smooth glaze that prevents particles from sticking to the ceramic. This feature, combined with the high efficiency flush, helps reduce the frequency of toilet cleaning, minimizing the use of water, harsh chemicals, and the time required for cleaning. description.html: ? The modern DeerValley Dual-Flush Elongated One-Piece Toilet with a full-skirted bowl has clean lines and presents a simple and elegant visual experience, suitable for most styles of bathrooms. The unique fan-shaped design on the side incorporates an Oriental aesthetic. Concealed trap-way and seamless design make cleaning easier. Dual-flush functionality offers more options and maximizes efficacy, the super Jet siphon flush provides a powerful flush that keeps the toilet from clogging and saves water. High temperature-calcined ceramic glaze integrated white toilet has a strong texture, good pressure resistance, strong corrosion resistance, and good scratch resistance. In addition, the toilet seat has a soft-close function to reduce collision noise, and the seat has a large contact area with your butt, providing a quiet and comfortable experience. Features The side of the DeerValley one-piece toilet has a unique fan-shaped design with a classical Oriental aesthetic. It brings an elegant experience to your bathroom. This elongated toilet seat allows more contact with your butt and legs, allowing you to feel comfortable without numbness. Soft closed seat design reduces noise and brings you peace. A toilet seat with a soft closing function can avoid excessive force when closing the toilet seat which is beneficial to prolong the service life.
